A compact embodied intelligent mobile robot with a robotic arm, multi-sensor fusion (vision, LiDAR, voice), and flexible development interfaces, designed for scalable deployment in research and industrial applications.

Specs

JAKA Lumi is a mobile embodied robot with 12 degrees of freedom, a six-axis robotic arm, dual vision cameras, LiDAR, and voice interaction. It features a 0–400 mm waist lift, ±160° waist rotation, multiple industrial communication protocols (TCP/IP, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), and supports secondary development via SDK interfaces.

The story behind LUMI

LUMI was created in Romania, by parents looking for a real alternative to the tablet. We combined AI technology (ChatGPT) with a child-friendly design and advanced parental controls.

Ailumi Toy is a Romanian brand. Our mission: fewer screens, more moments that matter.

Made with care, for families like yours. 💜

How does LUMI work? 5 simple steps
1
›
You set up

You connect LUMI to Wi-Fi through the TUYA app.

2
›
You personalise

You set the language, the preferences and the rules for your child.

3
›
You talk

The child starts the conversation: “What shall we talk about?”

4
›
You monitor

In the app you see the conversations and you stay fully in control.

5
Calm

A safety filter that blocks unsuitable topics.
